Alex — thanks for the quick numbers and the filled template. Attached is a short pricing sketch (2 pages) and a 1-page unit-econ appendix. Key bullets:

- Proposal (hosted):
  - 0–500M: $15,000/1M tokens (effective)
  - 500M–1B: $13,000/1M tokens
  - 1B+: $11,000/1M tokens
- Route adjustments (folded into blended):
  - Notifications route: +6% uplift applied to the route weight
  - Receipts-parsing: +4% uplift
- Example blended result at 700M with route mix (notifications 25%, receipts 10%): effective $/1M ≈ $13,400 -> monthly run-rate ≈ $9.38M
- Dedicated commit option: 20% lower unit rates at comparable commit (requires 12-month minimum).

Requested from Sierra: please confirm which volume scenario you want us to price (conservative/base/optimistic) and whether you prefer hosted or dedicated pricing for negotiation. Also: highlight any internal constraints around PO timing or the need for a longer trial.
